snippet.title: GET RAMMED - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW!!! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4612760/GET_RAMMED/

GET RAMMED is a multiplayer party game with up to 8 players where you play as chaotic goats trying to RAM each other off the stage! Challenge each other with a playful mix of unique maps, power-ups and unexpected events!

Credits:

🎵 Music - Conor Mitchell McCullagh (ConorIsHere) - https://conorishere.my.canva.site/
🎥 Editor  - Stuart Proctor - https://alwayscosmic.carrd.co/
